question: 44. What are the speakers preparing for?
article_text:
44. What are the speakers preparing for?
(A)
An awards ceremony
(B)
An automobile show
(C)
A presentation for investors
(D)
A fund-raiser for charities
Mục đích

DẪN CHỨNG

“About twelve of our investors are attending the presentation”

Xem trong bài

“many of the investors coming are excited about the chance to finally test-drive our new electric cars”

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

Cụm 'investors are attending the presentation' cho thấy sự kiện là buổi thuyết trình dành cho nhà đầu tư, không phải lễ trao giải hay triển lãm xe. Việc chuẩn bị catering và lịch tập duyệt đều phục vụ cho buổi thuyết trình này.

Chọn C — A presentation for investors.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Lễ trao giải không được nhắc đến, chỉ nói về nhà đầu tư và thuyết trình.

(B): Có nhắc đến xe điện, nhưng sự kiện là thuyết trình cho nhà đầu tư, không phải triển lãm xe.

(D): Không có thông tin về gây quỹ từ thiện, chỉ tập trung vào nhà đầu tư.

choices.translation: Một buổi thuyết trình dành cho các nhà đầu tư
Một buổi gây quỹ từ thiện

Print out some programs

(D): Kiểm tra thiết bị không phải nhiệm vụ của cô ấy trong đoạn này.

Bạn chọn (A): Không nói về chi phí gian hàng.

(C): Không đề cập đến việc hội chợ chuyển sang không gian nhỏ hơn.

(D): Không nhắc đến việc quảng bá hội chợ.

60. Why does the woman say, "I'm hosting a dinner at my home at six o'clock tonight"?

To extend an invitation
(C)
To reject a suggestion
(D)
To confirm a location
Mục đích

“I'm hosting a dinner at my place at six tonight.”

Xem trong bài

Người phụ nữ nói rằng cô ấy tổ chức bữa tối lúc 6 giờ để giải thích rằng cô không thể chờ đến 7 giờ để nhân viên đến giúp. Điều này tương ứng với việc cô ấy từ chối đề xuất của người quản lý.

Chọn D — Pick up a key.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Chuẩn bị đồ ăn là hoạt động cho bữa tối, không phải hành động tiếp theo.

(B): Không có chi tiết nào về việc đi làm.

(C): Không gọi thợ sửa mà được hướng dẫn đến lấy chìa khóa.

question: 62. Look at the graphic. What is the woman's office number?

62. Look at the graphic. What is the woman's office number?
(A)
900
(B)
920
(C)
960
(D)
972
Đọc bảng biểu

DẪN CHỨNG

“Hello, this is Sonya Bauman speaking.”

Ở lượt nói mở đầu, người phụ nữ tự giới thiệu tên để xác định nhân vật cần đối chiếu với tên công ty trên bảng.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Xin chào, tôi là Sonya Bauman.

2

Paraphrase

Sonya Bauman = Bauman Law Firm.

3

Đối chiếu bảng

Tên Bauman khớp với Bauman Law Firm; số phòng ghi bên cạnh công ty này là 920.

Chọn B — 920.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A) · Bẫy lệch tên: Sai. 900 thuộc Wilbur's Finance, không phải Bauman Law Firm.

(C) · Bẫy lệch tên: Sai. 960 thuộc Showa Dentistry, không phải Bauman Law Firm.

(D) · Bẫy lệch tên: Sai. 972 thuộc Cohen Textiles, không phải Bauman Law Firm.

CẦN NHỚ

Quy tắc: Xác định đúng tên người hoặc công ty trong transcript, rồi lấy số nằm cùng dòng trên bảng. Dấu hiệu: “Sonya Bauman”, “Bauman Law Firm”, “920”.

66. Look at the graphic. Which feature does the man suggest focusing on?
(A)
Free shipping
(B)
Lifetime warranty
(C)
Annual maintenance
(D)
Loyalty program
Đọc bảng biểu

DẪN CHỨNG

“Hmm... I see that we provide a feature that Technology Brothers doesn't. I think we should focus on promoting that.”

Ở lượt nói thứ ba, người đàn ông xác định tính năng riêng của Newton Electronics và đề xuất quảng bá tính năng đó.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Tôi thấy chúng ta cung cấp một tính năng mà Technology Brothers không có. Tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên tập trung quảng bá tính năng đó.

2

Paraphrase

a feature that Technology Brothers doesn't = tính năng Newton Electronics có nhưng Technology Brothers không có; focus on promoting that = tập trung quảng bá tính năng đó.

3

Đối chiếu bảng

Lifetime Warranty là tính năng duy nhất Newton Electronics có mà Technology Brothers không có. Free Shipping và Annual Maintenance có ở cả hai bên, còn Loyalty Program chỉ thuộc về Technology Brothers.

Chọn B — Lifetime warranty.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A) · Bẫy thiếu lợi thế: Sai. Free shipping có ở cả hai nhà cung cấp, nên không tạo lợi thế riêng cho Newton Electronics.

(C) · Bẫy thiếu lợi thế: Sai. Annual maintenance được cả Newton Electronics và Technology Brothers cung cấp.

(D) · Bẫy ngược nhà cung cấp: Sai. Loyalty program là tính năng chỉ Technology Brothers có, không phải Newton Electronics.

CẦN NHỚ

Trong câu hỏi dạng chart: tiêu chí cần chọn = đặc điểm chỉ phía được hỏi có và đối thủ không có (✓/KHÔNG có). Dấu hiệu nhận biết là “a feature ... doesn't”, “focus on promoting” và các cột ✓/KHÔNG có trong bảng.

Người phụ nữ nói sẽ liên hệ với đội marketing, tức là sẽ liên lạc với đồng nghiệp.

Chọn D — Contact some coworkers.

Dịch dẫn chứng

Paraphrase

next to the microwave = ở cạnh lò vi sóng; put it there instead = đặt thiết bị ở vị trí đó thay cho vị trí cạnh tủ lạnh.

Đối chiếu hình

(B) · Bẫy ngược bên: Sai. Location #2 là ổ cắm bên trái bồn rửa, còn lò vi sóng nằm ở phía bên phải.

(D) · Bẫy lệch độ cao: Sai. Location #4 nằm ở mặt tủ bếp dưới, không phải khu vực cạnh lò vi sóng.

(C): Có nhắc đến ong và nông nghiệp, nhưng không phải chăm sóc sức khỏe tự nhiên.

(C): Apologize for a delayed order là xin lỗi vì đơn hàng trễ, nhưng người nói không xin lỗi mà dùng thông tin này để biện minh cho mở rộng.

96. Look at the graphic. Which day is the appointment scheduled for?
(A)
Monday
(B)
Tuesday
(C)
Wednesday
(D)
Friday
Đọc bảng biểu

DẪN CHỨNG

“Well, I just passed the café, and I saw a sign in the window saying that it doesn't open until ten o'clock.”

Ở giữa bài nói, sau khi nêu giờ hẹn, người nói phát hiện giờ mở cửa của quán không khớp với cuộc hẹn.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Tôi vừa đi ngang qua quán và thấy một biển báo trên cửa sổ nói rằng quán đến 10 giờ mới mở cửa.

2

Paraphrase

doesn't open until ten = mở cửa lúc 10:00; cuộc hẹn lúc 9:00 không thể rơi vào ngày quán mở từ 9:00 hoặc 8:00.

3

Đối chiếu bảng

Trong bảng, Tuesday là ngày duy nhất quán mở cửa từ 10:00 A.M.; vì vậy cuộc hẹn lúc 9:00 vào ngày hôm sau phải là Tuesday.

Chọn B — Tuesday.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A) · Bẫy mâu thuẫn: Sai. Thứ Hai thuộc nhóm Saturday–Monday, quán đóng cửa cả ngày; không thể có giờ mở cửa 10:00.

(C) · Bẫy ngược mốc: Sai. Thứ Tư mở từ 9:00 A.M.; câu “doesn't open until ten” cho biết quán chưa mở lúc 9:00.

(D) · Bẫy ngược mốc: Sai. Thứ Sáu mở từ 8:00 A.M.; lúc 9:00 quán đã mở, trái với thông báo phải đến 10:00.

CẦN NHỚ

Công thức: thời điểm trong transcript + giờ mở cửa trên bảng = ngày phù hợp. Dấu hiệu: “tomorrow morning at nine”, “doesn't open until ten”, và dòng Tuesday 10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.

SUY LUẬN

Chọn D — Change a meeting location.

question: 98. Why does the man apologize?

98. Why does the man apologize?
(A)
He forgot to send a package.
(B)
He did not confirm a visit earlier.
(C)
He did not complete a report on time.
(D)
He went to the wrong address.

(C): Không nhắc đến việc hoàn thành báo cáo.

(D): Không có chi tiết nào về việc đến sai địa chỉ.

question: 101. ------- is currently Ms. Wonderle"s first year working as our office"s administrative assistant.
article_text:
101. ------- is currently Ms. Wonderle"s first year working as our office"s administrative assistant.
(A)
This
(B)
That
(C)
These
(D)
Those
Kết hợp từ

SUY LUẬN

1

Vị trí chỗ trống

Chỗ trống nằm trong câu "___ is currently Ms. Wonderle"s first year working as our office"s administrative assistant.", ngay trước/sau các thành phần đã cho; vị trí này cần một từ có vai trò ngữ pháp phù hợp với phần còn lại của câu.

2

Tiêu chí quyết định

Cần đại từ chỉ thị số ít kết hợp với động từ "is". Cấu trúc "This is...year" dùng để giới thiệu hoặc nhấn mạnh. Các tùy chọn "These" và "Those" là số nhiều không thể dùng với động từ số ít "is". "That" cũng là số ít nhưng không phù hợp trong ngữ cảnh này vì không thể nói "That is...Ms. Wonderle's first year". Chỉ "This" là đúng, mang ý nghĩa "Đây là" hoặc "Cái này là".

Chọn A. This.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

(B) · Bẫy từ loại: Sai. "That" xuất hiện trong các phương án nhưng không tạo được cấu trúc hoặc ý nghĩa mà câu đang cần.

(C) · Bẫy từ loại: Sai. "These" xuất hiện trong các phương án nhưng không tạo được cấu trúc hoặc ý nghĩa mà câu đang cần.

(D) · Bẫy từ loại: Sai. "Those" xuất hiện trong các phương án nhưng không tạo được cấu trúc hoặc ý nghĩa mà câu đang cần.

CẦN NHỚ

Cần đại từ chỉ thị số ít kết hợp với động từ "is". Cấu trúc "This is...year" dùng để giới thiệu hoặc nhấn mạnh. Các tùy chọn "These" và "Those" là số nhiều không thể dùng với động từ số ít "is". "That" cũng là số ít nhưng không phù hợp trong ngữ cảnh này vì không thể nói "That is...Ms. Wonderle's first year". Chỉ "This" là đúng, mang ý nghĩa "Đây là" hoặc "Cái này là". Dấu hiệu nhận biết: nhìn vào cấu trúc quanh chỗ trống và các từ/cụm như "This" để áp dụng quy tắc tương tự ở câu khác.

question: 110. Later today, Mr. Warken ------- interview times for the job applicant finalists.
article_text:
110. Later today, Mr. Warken ------- interview times for the job applicant finalists.
(A)
has been arranging
(B)
will be arranging
(C)
was arranged
(D)
have arranged
Ngữ pháp

SUY LUẬN

1

Vị trí chỗ trống

Chỗ trống nằm trong câu "Later today, Mr. Warken ___ interview times for the job applicant finalists.", ngay trước/sau các thành phần đã cho; vị trí này cần một từ có vai trò ngữ pháp phù hợp với phần còn lại của câu.

2

Tiêu chí quyết định

Cần thì tương lai tiếp diễn (future continuous tense) vì có cụm từ "Later today" chỉ thời gian trong tương lai. Cấu trúc đúng là "will be arranging". Các tùy chọn khác không phù hợp: "has been arranging" (thì hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn), "was arranged" (thì quá khứ bị động), "have arranged" (thì hiện tại hoàn thành). Chỉ "will be arranging" là thì đúng để diễn tả một hành động sẽ đang diễn ra trong tương lai.

Chọn B. will be arranging.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

question: 147. What is the purpose of the sign?
article_text:
147. What is the purpose of the sign?
(A)
To announce a temporary closure
(B)
To advertise a new product line
(C)
To explain how shelves are arranged
(D)
To prepare customers for an upcoming change
Mục đích

DẪN CHỨNG

“Following the expansion of our store, and prompted by requests from customers for more products, many of the items between aisles 2 and 20 will now be relocated.”

Dẫn chứng nằm ở đoạn chứa thông tin trực tiếp về đối tượng hoặc hành động được hỏi.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Sau khi mở rộng cửa hàng của chúng tôi, và được thúc đẩy bởi yêu cầu từ khách hàng về nhiều sản phẩm hơn, nhiều mặt hàng giữa các lối 2 và 20 sẽ được chuyển lên.

2

Paraphrase

"Following the expansion of our store, and prompted by requests from customers for more products, man" = "To prepare customers for an upcoming change". Cụm thông tin trong bài được viết lại thành lựa chọn đúng, nên không chọn các phương án chỉ lặp từ nhưng lệch ý.

Chọn D. To prepare customers for an upcoming change.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Bài không nêu "To announce a temporary closure"; chi tiết quyết định lại dẫn tới "To prepare customers for an upcoming change".

(B): Sai. Bài không nêu "To advertise a new product line"; chi tiết quyết định lại dẫn tới "To prepare customers for an upcoming change".

(C): Sai. Bài không nêu "To explain how shelves are arranged"; chi tiết quyết định lại dẫn tới "To prepare customers for an upcoming change".

CẦN NHỚ

Đáp án đọc hiểu phải được nối từ câu dẫn chứng sang cách diễn đạt tương đương trong lựa chọn, không chỉ dựa vào từ lặp lại. Dấu hiệu nhận biết ở câu này là "To prepare customers for an upcoming change" gắn với chi tiết được trích trong bài.

Questions 151-152 refer to the following article.

BAKERSVILLE (August 13)—As confirmed by today's vote, the city's building code is getting a shake-up. Among the changes to go into effect on November 3 are stricter fire safety standards for both commercial and residential buildings, enhanced insulation requirements, and, most notably, a requirement that 25 percent of newly constructed residential homes be equipped with solar panels.

The solar initiative has been met with broad support among voters, lawmakers, and home builders. The new rule will increase the total amount of green energy produced and reduce dependency on fossil fuels. Supporters also say that increasing demand for solar panels and hardware will drive prices down, so that this technology will be increasingly affordable. Finally, though the building phase will be more costly than usual, homeowners will save on electricity bills in the long term.

The state will open a phone hotline to answer questions from builders, property owners, contractors, and other affected parties beginning on October 15 and continuing through the end of the year.

To maintain a healthy plant, pinch or cut off parts of the plant that have turned brown or withered. Doing so helps to facilitate new growth. Each spring, repot your plant in a larger pot to allow room for the root system to grow.

(B)

(C)
To support local garden centers
(D)

Paraphrase

Chọn B. To promote plant growth.

Sincerely,
Barry Robledo

Questions 172-175 refer to the following article.
AFEC Offers Pathway to Success

By Pauline Weston

BRIDGETOWN (29 October)—From 14 to 16 November, the Association of Female Entrepreneurs of the Caribbean (AFEC) will be hosting its fourth biennial forum at the Centre for Labour Force Development in Bridgetown, Barbados. This year's theme, "From Aspiration to Sensation," is centered on the essential skills and tools needed to start, run, and grow a successful business. — [1] —. About 350 women will be interacting with some of the region's most successful women business leaders through a series of presentations. — [2] —.

One presenter will be Serena Telting, owner of Suriname-based children's clothing manufacturer Serenatee. She welcomes the opportunity to share her experience with conference goers. — [3] —. "Specifically," she says, "I will be promoting a set of sound practices that I have adopted over my fifteen years in the apparel industry. Those might shield emerging entrepreneurs from the challenges I faced early on in my career. Because I lacked adequate advice when I started my business, I made some mistakes that nearly ruined it."

Attendees are keen on engaging with their established peers. Madelon Picard, a native of Martinique who plans to open a nursery school on the island, says, "I am eager to learn how my role models dealt with challenges and accomplished their achievements." — [4] —. Ms. Picard also referenced the assistance she has received from the Martinique Business Society (MBS), of which she is a member. "The MBS is fully funding my participation in the AFEC forum, from hotel accommodation and airfare to meals and local transport." She is far from the exception. Organisers say they have seen a significant increase in financial support for attendees since the first AFEC forum.

Questions 172-175 refer to the following article.
AFEC Offers Pathway to Success

By Pauline Weston

BRIDGETOWN (29 October)—From 14 to 16 November, the Association of Female Entrepreneurs of the Caribbean (AFEC) will be hosting its fourth biennial forum at the Centre for Labour Force Development in Bridgetown, Barbados. This year's theme, "From Aspiration to Sensation," is centered on the essential skills and tools needed to start, run, and grow a successful business. — [1] —. About 350 women will be interacting with some of the region's most successful women business leaders through a series of presentations. — [2] —.

One presenter will be Serena Telting, owner of Suriname-based children's clothing manufacturer Serenatee. She welcomes the opportunity to share her experience with conference goers. — [3] —. "Specifically," she says, "I will be promoting a set of sound practices that I have adopted over my fifteen years in the apparel industry. Those might shield emerging entrepreneurs from the challenges I faced early on in my career. Because I lacked adequate advice when I started my business, I made some mistakes that nearly ruined it."

Attendees are keen on engaging with their established peers. Madelon Picard, a native of Martinique who plans to open a nursery school on the island, says, "I am eager to learn how my role models dealt with challenges and accomplished their achievements." — [4] —. Ms. Picard also referenced the assistance she has received from the Martinique Business Society (MBS), of which she is a member. "The MBS is fully funding my participation in the AFEC forum, from hotel accommodation and airfare to meals and local transport." She is far from the exception. Organisers say they have seen a significant increase in financial support for attendees since the first AFEC forum.

To:	Grace Wu
From:	Carlos Garcia
Subject:	Employee of the Month
Date:	July 25

Dear Grace:

I am writing to nominate a member of our production team, Dwight Clinton, as a candidate for Franklin Appliances' Employee of the Month. We have been working diligently to complete the design of a more energy-efficient air-conditioning unit by our July 31 deadline, and Mr. Clinton's participation on the team has made it possible for us to meet our challenging targets.

In his eight years at Franklin Appliances, Mr. Clinton has demonstrated the capacity to grow both professionally and personally. He began as an apprentice and has steadily worked his way up to Testing Engineer. Mr. Clinton has been instrumental in helping us realize the company's mission of designing high-quality energy-saving refrigerators, ovens, washing machines, and cooling systems. It would be difficult to envision meeting our product deadlines without his contribution to every project he is assigned to.

Thank you for your consideration.

Carlos

To: All employees
From: Grace Wu
Date: August 1
Subject: Employee of the Month

It is my privilege to announce that Dwight Clinton has been chosen to be our July Employee of the Month. Franklin Appliances promotes an environment of creative collaboration, and Mr. Clinton has demonstrated the leadership and support necessary to help make this mission a reality. Thanks in large part to his commendable efforts, we are pleased to announce that our newest product, the Eco-Cool Wave, was successfully launched yesterday.

Mr. Clinton has dedicated a large part of his professional life to rising through the ranks at Franklin Appliances. His story is indicative of the supportive environment that the company offers by promoting internally and providing professional growth as well as development opportunities.

Franklin Appliances is honored to present Mr. Clinton with two paid personal days to use at his discretion. The next time you see Dwight, please offer your congratulations!

Questions 176-180 refer to the following e-mail and report.
To:	Grace Wu
From:	Carlos Garcia
Subject:	Employee of the Month
Date:	July 25

Dear Grace:

I am writing to nominate a member of our production team, Dwight Clinton, as a candidate for Franklin Appliances' Employee of the Month. We have been working diligently to complete the design of a more energy-efficient air-conditioning unit by our July 31 deadline, and Mr. Clinton's participation on the team has made it possible for us to meet our challenging targets.

In his eight years at Franklin Appliances, Mr. Clinton has demonstrated the capacity to grow both professionally and personally. He began as an apprentice and has steadily worked his way up to Testing Engineer. Mr. Clinton has been instrumental in helping us realize the company's mission of designing high-quality energy-saving refrigerators, ovens, washing machines, and cooling systems. It would be difficult to envision meeting our product deadlines without his contribution to every project he is assigned to.

Thank you for your consideration.

Carlos

To: All employees
From: Grace Wu
Date: August 1
Subject: Employee of the Month

It is my privilege to announce that Dwight Clinton has been chosen to be our July Employee of the Month. Franklin Appliances promotes an environment of creative collaboration, and Mr. Clinton has demonstrated the leadership and support necessary to help make this mission a reality. Thanks in large part to his commendable efforts, we are pleased to announce that our newest product, the Eco-Cool Wave, was successfully launched yesterday.

Mr. Clinton has dedicated a large part of his professional life to rising through the ranks at Franklin Appliances. His story is indicative of the supportive environment that the company offers by promoting internally and providing professional growth as well as development opportunities.

Franklin Appliances is honored to present Mr. Clinton with two paid personal days to use at his discretion. The next time you see Dwight, please offer your congratulations!

Carlos

group_text:
Questions 176-180 refer to the following e-mail and report.
To:	Grace Wu
From:	Carlos Garcia
Subject:	Employee of the Month
Date:	July 25

Dear Grace:

I am writing to nominate a member of our production team, Dwight Clinton, as a candidate for Franklin Appliances' Employee of the Month. We have been working diligently to complete the design of a more energy-efficient air-conditioning unit by our July 31 deadline, and Mr. Clinton's participation on the team has made it possible for us to meet our challenging targets.

In his eight years at Franklin Appliances, Mr. Clinton has demonstrated the capacity to grow both professionally and personally. He began as an apprentice and has steadily worked his way up to Testing Engineer. Mr. Clinton has been instrumental in helping us realize the company's mission of designing high-quality energy-saving refrigerators, ovens, washing machines, and cooling systems. It would be difficult to envision meeting our product deadlines without his contribution to every project he is assigned to.

Thank you for your consideration.

Carlos

To: All employees
From: Grace Wu
Date: August 1
Subject: Employee of the Month

It is my privilege to announce that Dwight Clinton has been chosen to be our July Employee of the Month. Franklin Appliances promotes an environment of creative collaboration, and Mr. Clinton has demonstrated the leadership and support necessary to help make this mission a reality. Thanks in large part to his commendable efforts, we are pleased to announce that our newest product, the Eco-Cool Wave, was successfully launched yesterday.

Mr. Clinton has dedicated a large part of his professional life to rising through the ranks at Franklin Appliances. His story is indicative of the supportive environment that the company offers by promoting internally and providing professional growth as well as development opportunities.

Franklin Appliances is honored to present Mr. Clinton with two paid personal days to use at his discretion. The next time you see Dwight, please offer your congratulations!

http://www.inganirobotics.co.uk ▶

Ingani Robotics

In today's mail-order industry, turnaround time is key. Ingani's machines can take the physical labour out of item retrieval. Our self-navigating, fully rechargeable freight movers can increase your efficiency without the need for extra staff. They function safely in shared environments with people. Aliya Almansouri

Paul

To:	All Staff <allstaff@sielendgroup.co.za>

Date:	1 February
Subject:	Farewell party

Dear Colleagues,

As you may have heard, our friend and colleague Gerard Clegg will be leaving Sielend Group at the end of February after 22 years. During his tenure as CFO, Gerard implemented state-of-the-art budget-management software and presided over a threefold growth in company revenues.

Gerard has expressed mixed feelings about departing but says that he plans to work part-time alongside his brother at the local firm Chartera Consultants. Gerard will also continue to be involved with youth five hours a week at the nonprofit Reach-Out Durban League.

Please join us in attending Gerard's farewell party at 7:00 P.M. on Friday, 28 February, at Longres Ballroom here in Durban. Light refreshments will be served, and the company president will present Gerard with a plaque to show our appreciation for his many contributions to the company.

If you plan to attend, please e-mail my assistant Seojung Lee to let her know. We would like to know in advance how many people to expect. We look forward to seeing you there.

Thanks,

Orson Stanley

Questions 191-195 refer to the following e-mail, Web page, and notice.
To:	All Staff <allstaff@sielendgroup.co.za>
From:	Orson Stanley <ostanley@sielendgroup.co.za>
Date:	1 February
Subject:	Farewell party

Dear Colleagues,

As you may have heard, our friend and colleague Gerard Clegg will be leaving Sielend Group at the end of February after 22 years. During his tenure as CFO, Gerard implemented state-of-the-art budget-management software and presided over a threefold growth in company revenues.

Gerard has expressed mixed feelings about departing but says that he plans to work part-time alongside his brother at the local firm Chartera Consultants. Gerard will also continue to be involved with youth five hours a week at the nonprofit Reach-Out Durban League.

Please join us in attending Gerard's farewell party at 7:00 P.M. on Friday, 28 February, at Longres Ballroom here in Durban. Light refreshments will be served, and the company president will present Gerard with a plaque to show our appreciation for his many contributions to the company.

If you plan to attend, please e-mail my assistant Seojung Lee to let her know. We would like to know in advance how many people to expect. We look forward to seeing you there.

Thanks,

Orson Stanley

Questions 196-200 refer to the following advertisement and e-mails.
CLAREGAL TOURS 🚌

Claregal Tours has been showing visitors Western Ireland's most iconic sights for the past fifteen years. Our buses are comfortable, air-conditioned, and include Wi-Fi. Our experienced drivers and guides are well versed in Ireland's history and culture. All excursions are day-long tours and leave from the bus terminal in Galway.

Aran Islands (ARI423)

Spend the day island hopping between these three beautiful islands where you will see ancient ruins, visit a local farm, and have a chance to explore by bicycle. Ferry transportation fees included.

Adult: €30, University Student: €25, Child: €20

Aran Islands and Cliffs of Moher (AIM523)

Take your time exploring one of the scenic Aran Islands, Inisheer, and then take a ferry to get up close to the Cliffs of Moher. Ferry transportation fees included.

Adult: €40, University Student: €35, Child: €30

Connemara (CON234)

See the beautiful national park of Connemara, where nature is at its finest. Choose from several hiking options with varying degrees of difficulty.

Adult: €35, University Student: €30, Child: €25

Galway (GAL324)

Get off the bus and into the city with this walking tour of Galway. Along the way, you will have the chance to hear traditional music, visit a pub, and see an Irish step dancing performance.

Adult: €20, University Student: €18, Child: €15

I would like to set your schedule for August.

See you tomorrow,

Helen Doyle

Tour Manager, Claregal Tours

Claregal Tours

Questions 196-200 refer to the following advertisement and e-mails.
CLAREGAL TOURS 🚌

Claregal Tours has been showing visitors Western Ireland's most iconic sights for the past fifteen years. Our buses are comfortable, air-conditioned, and include Wi-Fi. Our experienced drivers and guides are well versed in Ireland's history and culture. All excursions are day-long tours and leave from the bus terminal in Galway.

Aran Islands (ARI423)

Spend the day island hopping between these three beautiful islands where you will see ancient ruins, visit a local farm, and have a chance to explore by bicycle. Ferry transportation fees included.

Adult: €30, University Student: €25, Child: €20

Aran Islands and Cliffs of Moher (AIM523)

Take your time exploring one of the scenic Aran Islands, Inisheer, and then take a ferry to get up close to the Cliffs of Moher. Ferry transportation fees included.

Adult: €40, University Student: €35, Child: €30

Connemara (CON234)

See the beautiful national park of Connemara, where nature is at its finest. Choose from several hiking options with varying degrees of difficulty.

Adult: €35, University Student: €30, Child: €25

Galway (GAL324)

Get off the bus and into the city with this walking tour of Galway. Along the way, you will have the chance to hear traditional music, visit a pub, and see an Irish step dancing performance.

Adult: €20, University Student: €18, Child: €15

From:	Helen Doyle
Date:	8 July
Subject:	Tomorrow's tour
Attachment:	📎 9 July Trip

Hi Alan and Siobhan,

I have attached the final list of passengers for tomorrow's tour with its itinerary. Alan will be the driver/guide, and Siobhan will be doing passenger check-in. The clients have requested that you drive them to a café to get breakfast before going to Inisheer, which is different from our usual itinerary, but I agreed. It should take one hour. Just a reminder that last month we changed the departure time from 9:30 A.M. to 9:15 A.M. Alan, when you are finished with the tour today, please come by my office. I would like to set your schedule for August.

See you tomorrow,

Helen Doyle

Tour Manager, Claregal Tours

Claregal Tours
